p02_interaction_comparison.metric_note: This is coherent two-speaker interaction relative to incoherent left+right energy; it is not the P02-normalized relative level, whose value is 0 dB by definition.

methods.09: Full reference convolved with each RIR, sum waveforms, sosfiltfilt on full sum, then 8 s windows at 6-14/21-29/36-44 s; mean-square -> 10log10.
methods.11_13: Core 6-14 s spectrum, Butterworth response magnitude^4 (forward-backward power), Parseval weighted RIR transfer energy; coherent sum before energy; P02 both-speaker energy normalization.

diagnosis.likely_difference: 09 includes finite-window convolution/filter edge and the full reference timing; 11/13 use steady-state frequency-domain energy and omit finite-window transient/tail effects. Filter definitions are otherwise the same 4th-order Butterworth bandpass, but 11/13 apply its idealized |H|^4 weighting.
